crom_guide.text: Oliver Cromwell lived here with his family from 1636, collecting the local church taxes, before he was famous. Or infamous, depending who you ask.
He was MP for Cambridge, then a general in the Civil War, then Lord Protector, ruling Britain without a king from 1653 until he died in 1658.
Round here, folk remember he stood up for the fenmen when the drainers took their common land. Elsewhere, folk remember rather different things.

crom_ghosthunter.text: They say his ghost walks the upstairs. I've been here six nights with a thermometer. It went down once. That was the door.
